steps.description: AC-1: Confirm canonical sync policy modes (`disabled|manual|by_phase|by_milestone|custom_phase_list`) are documented with default non-auto behavior (`SYNC_POLICY_MODE=manual`).
AC-2: Confirm sync eligibility evaluation executes only at phase-completion boundaries.
AC-3: Confirm mandatory `TEST_COMMAND` pre-push gate blocks push on missing command, failure, or timeout.
AC-4: Confirm optional checks (`LINT_COMMAND`, `TYPECHECK_COMMAND`, formatter/lint-fix) are honored only when configured and reported deterministically.
AC-5: Confirm feature auto-push before QA completion is forbidden; only manual sync is allowed before QA pass.
AC-6: Confirm unresolved blocking QA findings prevent auto-push and provide actionable remediation guidance.
AC-7: Confirm branch safety constraints enforce deny-by-default behavior unless explicit allowlist opt-in exists.
AC-8: Confirm deterministic sync evidence includes policy mode, phase boundary, checks run, push decision, reason code, and evidence references.
AC-9: Confirm `scripts/validate-and-push.ps1` and `.sh` remain behaviorally aligned for mandatory test gating and optional-check semantics.
AC-10: Confirm disabled/manual default modes preserve near-zero overhead and existing manual push workflow.
